Alrighty, after writing this big scary message we realised that some recent changes made the migration rather easy to write! 😅 So, the database will migrate automatically to the new schema and there's no need to resync 🎉 The migration will take several minutes and will happen automatically the next time Lighthouse starts after the upgrade. The PR is merging now, so expect your next update to take several minutes (but there's no re-sync required!). (The several minute migration only applies to testnets that have already undergone the merge. Mainnet and Prater are unaffected.) Well if this continues we may reach the scenario in bbts 1559 discussion where block rewards need to be increased 😂 x= months to merge, y= 10, !x<y? `x = y / 0` !x < (y / 0) + y Will SF4 be streamed? If so, link to YT pl0x? Well if the bomb keeps going gas is going to get high while block issuance gets lower which should make for sustained deflation. Will be an interesting thing to watch. Similar to a post merge pre withdrawal environment. No sorry, but you can follow here; https://ethstats.mainnetshadowfork4.ethdevops.io/ Given the sync issues w Erigon, when will know if they did in fact merge without issues?
